BiblicalUsage: Zoheth is named once, as a son of Ishi of the tribe of Judah. His name means 'releasing,' and he stands in the genealogy beside his brother Ben-zoheth, whose name carries his father's name forward. No deed of his is recorded — only his place in Judah's line.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a name in Judah's line is never wasted ink: Zoheth belonged to the tribe through which the Messiah would come.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
